config.variant_a: Standard plan: clear price, basic benefits.
config.variant_b: Same price, transparent privacy controls and a free trial.

cooperator.name: 合作型 · Cooperator
cooperator.description: 教学用合成人格，重视共同收益。参数为工程建模假设，未经心理测量校准。

reciprocator.name: 互惠型 · Reciprocator
reciprocator.description: 教学用合成人格，倾向根据可观察的合作历史调整行为。参数并非论文估计值。

cautious.name: 审慎型 · Cautious
cautious.description: 教学用合成人格，对不确定性与潜在损失较敏感。参数为可修改的演示假设。

explorer.name: 探索型 · Explorer
explorer.description: 教学用合成人格，偏好尝试新方案与承担风险。参数没有真实用户代表性保证。

ab_comparison.unit: persona_id × repetition; rounds averaged within unit
ab_comparison.caveat: Descriptive normal approximation over synthetic paired units; small samples and interacting agents violate population inference assumptions. Not a real-user causal effect.
